newsitem.title: CHINA: ATHLETICS-CHINA'S WANG JUNXIA RESUMES TRAINING.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CHINA'S WANG JUNXIA RESUMES TRAINING.

text.p: China's Olympic 5,000 metres champion Wang Junxia has resumed training after recovering from neurasthenia, state media said on Thursday.
"She is in good condition at present," state television said.
Wang had been forced to stop training after contracting neurasthenia, a nervous debility, earlier this year and had been suffering from severe headaches, it said.

Wang said the poor performance by the Chinese team at the World Championships in Athens, where China came away with no medals for the first time since 1983, was part of the reason she had decided to resume training, it said.
She declined to disclose her immediate goals, saying she did not want to train under too much pressure, it said.
Her coach Ma Dezhen said he expected Wang to regain part of her former strength by the end of this year, it said.

Wang, who rocketed to international prominence in 1993 when she shattered the world records for the 3,000 and 10,000 metres, was the 5,000 gold medal winner and 10,000 silver medallist at the Atlanta Olympics last year.
